dedupe_keys.name: world bank health nutrition and population statistics hnp database

description: This database brings together about 475 indicators on health, nutrition and population for more than 200 countries and regional and income aggregates. It is compiled by the World Bank from sources such as the World Health Organization, UNICEF and national statistical offices and published on the World Bank's DataBank. Indicators include health system capacity such as hospital beds, physicians, nurses and midwives per 1,000 people, health expenditure, immunisation coverage, births attended by skilled staff, disease prevalence, nutrition and population structure. Coverage is global at country level with annual values from 1960 where available; the source was last updated in July 2026. Data are free to explore and download from DataBank in Excel, CSV or text, and through the World Bank Indicators API (source 16). World Bank data are generally released under a Creative Commons Attribution licence; individual indicators may carry third-party terms. Caveats: many indicators have gaps and lags, definitions follow the originating agency and change over time, and national figures hide regional differences. Simulation uses: country-level healthcare capacity and demand inputs for resilience and capacity planning models and cross-country comparisons. Related records: the WHO Global Health Observatory health infrastructure indicators (data-who-gho-health-infrastructure-indicators) supply several of the underlying series, and the World Bank Service Delivery Indicators (data-world-bank-service-delivery-indicators-p02619) measure facility-level service quality.
